name: echo packet sniff
description: Proposal, packet sniffing as a picture, 40 cell lattice (12 px cells, the creature at 2x, a wire across its belly with slate packets riding it left to right, a steel magnifier in its left hand at the left edge that swells each packet as it crosses the glass): it watches the glass and blinks, one packet lights red under it with an antenna ping, its eyes follow the red one along the wire, its right forearm comes down and the fist plucks it off as it passes, lifts it up beside its head where it blinks red and white while the eyes look up at it with happy arches, then flicks it off the top corner with a spark and goes back to the glass; judge whether the packets read as data on a wire, whether the swelling under the glass reads as a magnifier, and whether the pluck reads with so short a forearm.
